kv260_hash_smoke.command:
ssh -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o BatchMode=yes kria 'python3 - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import json
payload = '"'"'{"edges": [[0, 1, 1], [1, 2, -1], [2, 3, 1], [3, 4, -1], [4, 5, 1], [6, 7, 1]], "expected_energy": 6, "experiment_id": "exp5243-hardware-continuity-kan-pbit-boundary-v479", "spins": [1, -1, -1, 1, 1, -1, 1, -1], "workload": "exp5243_inline_hash_ising_smoke"}'"'"'
data = json.loads(payload)
spins = [int(value) for value in data['"'"'spins'"'"']]
energy = 0
for row, col, coupling in data['"'"'edges'"'"']:
    energy -= int(coupling) * spins[int(row)] * spins[int(col)]
print(json.dumps({
    '"'"'board'"'"': '"'"'kv260'"'"',
    '"'"'workload_sha256'"'"': '"'"'3f59c2a7d70ef2beeaa6d9579a80ccf91d3a694254772dd2e340c6ae0d549a93'"'"',
    '"'"'executable_sha256'"'"': '"'"'5d28f49fa93716a9be5599154cd56eab19dbded60f372c322d6f03734eee72da'"'"',
    '"'"'inference_substrate'"'"': '"'"'hardware_reachability_hash_boundary'"'"',
    '"'"'energy'"'"': energy,
    '"'"'correctness'"'"': {'"'"'energy_matches_expected'"'"': energy == data['"'"'expected_energy'"'"']},
}, sort_keys=True))
PY'

field_principles.gatemate_status: Carry forward blocked_physical_jtag unless the operator changed physical setup.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Must start with complete:/complete_/success:/success_ or blocked_ and state board statuses with no speedup claim.
field_principles.kan_pbit_boundary_note_path: Repository path to the KAN/p-bit speedup-boundary note, or null if unwritten.
field_principles.kv260_ssh_only_confirmed: True only when KV260 was evaluated without host-visible block-device preconditions.
field_principles.kv260_status: Value is reachable only when SSH and the safe board-local hash smoke pass.
field_principles.physical_setup_changed: Boolean operator setup input controlling whether physical/JTAG probing is allowed.
field_principles.polarfire_status: Value is reachable only when SSH and the safe board-local hash smoke pass.
field_principles.safe_commands_run: List of bounded SSH/hash commands actually attempted, with pass/fail and exact error text.
field_principles.speedup_claimed: False because this artifact is reachability/hash continuity, not timing evidence.
